scope: Read-only primary-source research and local JSON/source inspection; no model imports, GPU use, training or project mutations.

detector_pretraining_overlap.official_recipe_dataset: COCO train2017 detection instances; validation uses val2017
detector_pretraining_overlap.uncertainty: The reference recipe removes images without valid detection annotations. It is not a per-image training manifest for the published checkpoint, so this audit establishes split overlap, not the exact number of local test images consumed during detector optimization.
detector_pretraining_overlap.recommended_disclosure: The caption test split was held out from our caption-model training. However, its images come from COCO train2017, the source split used by the pretrained COCO detector. Therefore it is not a clean image-level holdout from detector pretraining. Detector object-label supervision may have seen these images; this is not a claim that the detector saw their caption texts.
detector_pretraining_overlap.comparability: Comparison with the frozen ImageNet-pretrained stage-3 CNN is a practical system comparison. Detector pretraining, resolution, representation and supervision also differ; an improvement cannot be attributed only to using object regions.
detector_pretraining_overlap.action: Proceed with the disclosed limitation and unchanged project split. Do not silently relabel this as a clean detector-held-out test or alter existing experiment IDs. A stricter claim needs audited pretraining IDs excluding evaluation images or an independently held-out evaluation corpus.

butd_naming.original: ResNet-101 Faster R-CNN; 2048-dimensional mean-pooled regions; Visual Genome object and attribute supervision; authors align VG/COCO overlaps with Karpathy splits.
butd_naming.proposed: Torchvision ResNet-50 FPN Faster R-CNN; 1024-dimensional output from roi_heads.box_head; COCO detection supervision; project three-layer additive-attention LSTM.
butd_naming.recommended_name: Frozen detector ROI features with a three-layer additive-attention LSTM, inspired by bottom-up attention.
butd_naming.vg_overlap_note: Visual Genome pretraining is not automatically overlap-free. The original authors protect their Karpathy split; that does not establish protection for this project's separate random train2017 holdout.
butd_naming.caption_decoder_difference: Original bottom-up/top-down captioning uses specialized attention and language LSTMs; this project uses a stacked three-layer additive-attention LSTM.

stage4_fine_tuning_control.required_design: Clone the exact same completed stage-3 checkpoint into two new experiments: continued decoder training with CNN frozen, and CNN fine-tuning plus decoder continuation. Use the same extra epoch/update budget, caption choices, image order, preprocessing, validation protocol and comparable decoder optimizer/LR handling. Record the source checkpoint hash and all changed parameter groups.
stage4_fine_tuning_control.why: Comparing fine-tuning only against the earlier stopped stage-3 score mixes the effect of extra decoder optimization with the effect of unfreezing the CNN.
stage4_fine_tuning_control.early_stopping_note: For strictly matched additional epochs, run equal extra epochs or compare equal-epoch checkpoints. If using independent early stopping, describe it as equal maximum budget and report actual updates rather than claiming equal realized training.
stage4_fine_tuning_control.cached_vector_limitation: Saved vectors are detached from the CNN computation graph. Updating the encoder requires raw JPEG input and a fresh differentiable forward pass; changing cached vectors cannot fine-tune the original CNN.
stage4_fine_tuning_control.do_not_modify: Keep stage-3 checkpoints, caches, live kernels and result folders intact; use separate continuation/fine-tuning groups.

initial_B_scope.encoder: frozen torchvision fasterrcnn_resnet50_fpn with explicit COCO_V1 weights
initial_B_scope.mask_convention: Store a boolean valid-region mask and valid count; ensure at least one valid region. Record selection/NMS/threshold/ordering and deterministic empty-detection fallback in cache metadata.
initial_B_scope.comparison_control: The frozen stage-3 ResNet50 grid + three-layer additive-attention LSTM, once completed; do not substitute the later fine-tuned stage-4 model.
initial_B_scope.initialization: Train the new caption model from scratch with seed 42. Its 1024-input image projection is incompatible with the stage-3 2048-input projection; do not force-load stage-3 weights.
initial_B_scope.detector_input: Use raw RGB tensors in [0,1] with the detector's own transform. Record its resize limits and normalization. Do not blindly reuse the caption encoder's already-normalized 224-square tensors or normalize twice.
initial_B_scope.region_alignment: Public detector predictions are not ROI features. Preserve proposal/box-feature correspondence through selection and NMS, or explicitly recompute ROI features for selected boxes in detector-resized coordinates. Save boxes/scores/counts for audit.

existing_hardcodes: features.py SPATIAL_SHAPE=(49,2048) and spatial cache identity
config.py feature_dim2048, grid_size7, visual_tokens49 and build_model feature_dim2048
models.py initial_state averages every visual slot; attention softmax currently includes every slot
model_checks.py smoke asserts batch x49 x2048
shared collate/train/evaluation/greedy/overfit calls pass features without a region mask
required_B_changes: Create B-local model/dataset/runtime copies with a separate feature namespace, result group and implementation ID; do not edit A's stage-3 files.
Allow batch xN x1024 input. Propagate valid masks through collate, teacher forcing, greedy generation, evaluation, smoke and small-set overfit.
Use a masked visual mean for the initial image step and mask attention logits before softmax. Padded projected vectors contain Linear bias, so zero input padding alone is insufficient.

Reject an all-invalid image or apply a recorded deterministic fallback. Test mixed region counts, padded-region perturbation invariance, masked probability zero, finite normalized attention, gradients, greedy stopping and resume.
Keep all 5000 validation IDs and original caption references. Save plain/full best and last weights, config, vocabulary, RNG/optimizer/scaler, history, predictions and detector metadata.

shared_caption_protocol.train_caption_choice: one random human caption per image per epoch, private RNG seeded seed+epoch
shared_caption_protocol.metric_references: all original human captions; no vocabulary mapping
shared_caption_protocol.teacher_forcing: input captions[:,:-1], target captions[:,1:]; ignore PAD and average by non-PAD target tokens
shared_caption_protocol.generation: greedy from image and START; feed predicted token, stop END or 33, forbid PAD/START

cider_d.scale: native score, including the implementation's factor 10; no extra multiplication
cider_d.document_frequency: all reference sets in the evaluated split

tokenization.name: project_regex_v1
tokenization.note: Same tokenizer for predictions and raw references; not COCO leaderboard PTB tokenization.

provenance_to_include_in_handoff.delivery_note: Recompute SHA256 for the exact packaged notebook/prompt/code/data files and archive contents. Copy split IDs, vocabulary and original references unchanged. Save detector weight enum, downloaded weight SHA256, torchvision version, ROI feature tap/dimension, preprocessing, selection rules and cache hashes. Preserve original feature-cache keys as control provenance, but give ROI features new cache keys.

not_verified: No detector weights or models were loaded
No training or GPU work was performed
No actual stage-3 training checkpoint was found in the inspected spatial group at this read; comparison results must be filled from the completed stage-3 artifact later

region_primitive_read_only_review.alignment: Direct roi_heads output boxes remain in transformed coordinates. Re-ROIAlign and box_head use selected final boxes; manual rescaling to original image coordinates happens exactly once.
region_primitive_read_only_review.fallback_mask: The full-image fallback uses the transformed image bounds rather than batch padding. It has one valid region; padded rows have mask=False.
provenance_caveats: The detector-attached default metadata describes max_regions=36, score_threshold=0.2, nms_iou=0.5. If extraction arguments change, the cache writer must call region_feature_contract with the actual arguments instead of copying default metadata.

Torchvision NMS does not guarantee identical CPU/GPU selection for equal-score overlapping boxes. Stable pre-sorting does not establish cross-device bitwise reproducibility; record device and versions.
